newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain subdued on high dollar.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain subdued on high dollar.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained very quiet this afternoon as a higher dollar kept most buyers sidelined, market sources said.
"The high dollar discouraged many buyers from entering the market despite the weaker seller prices, even a higher Chicago soymeal futures opening failed to spark activity," one broker said.

Only three trades were reported this afternoon. Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets traded $3.5 lower at $303 and $303.50 and Aug/Oct EU rapemeal changed hands at 25 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, 0.10 marks down from yesterday.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
